finite_semantic_productions.reference_rule: The altitude argument is one value in MEASURE and SET, the solar degree is one value in SET and POINTER_AT, and the marker is one value in BORDER_READ and COUNT_FROM. Subsequent reads share one rete state until a written resetting action.
finite_semantic_productions.choice: The prerequisite general rule chooses east for before noon and west for after noon; the source example says right side. A shared interpretation must account for both descriptions without per-occurrence direction swaps.

semantic_consequence.interaction: Changing only the front-side altitude or only the later solar degree breaks the explicit transfer/reference identities. The time and ascendant must be outputs of the same fixed rete state, not independently chosen settings.

semantic_consequence.numeric_limit: The source supplies9o’clock/20Gemini but the full plate/calendar calibration is not owned here as executable data. No independent numerical derivation or accuracy of the1391 observation is asserted.
semantic_consequence.symmetry: Marker X is a conventional border index, not Roman ten or a confirmed cipher letter. Unbound instrument scales leave alternative mappings.
